# Neuro & Evil Karaoke API — Listening dashboard

Base URL: https://api.neurokaraoke.com (Production)

Aggregated listening statistics used by the public dashboard page.

### `GET /api/dashboard/summary` — Get the dashboard summary

Auth: none

Returns all dashboard data in a single response. Use the individual endpoints below when only one section is needed. `range` accepts `today` (default), `7d`, `30d`, `90d` or `all`. When both `from` and `to` are supplied, they take precedence over `range`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `range` | query | `string` | no | default: "today" |
| `from` | query | `date-time` | no |  |
| `to` | query | `date-time` | no |  |

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  lastRefreshed: string | null
  stats: {
    plays: int
    uniqueListeners: int
    avgSession: string | null
    topGenre: string | null
    uniqueSongsPlayed: int
    trends: {
      playsVsPrev: number
      uniqueListenersVsPrev: number
    }
  }
  genres: {
    genres: {
      name: string | null
      plays: int
    }[] | null
  }
  playsOverTime: {
    labels: string[] | null
    data: int[] | null
  }
  topSongs: {
    songs: {
      id: string | null
      slug: string | null
      title: string | null
      plays: int
      thumbnailUrl: string | null
    }[] | null
  }
  topArtists: {
    artists: {
      name: string | null
      plays: int
    }[] | null
  }
  coverArtists: {
    coverArtists: {
      name: string | null
      plays: int
    }[] | null
  }
}
```

### `GET /api/dashboard/stats` — Get summary stats

Auth: none

Returns the headline figures (total plays, listeners, etc.). `range` accepts `today` (default), `7d`, `30d`, `90d` or `all`. When both `from` and `to` are supplied, they take precedence over `range`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `range` | query | `string` | no | default: "today" |
| `from` | query | `date-time` | no |  |
| `to` | query | `date-time` | no |  |

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  plays: int
  uniqueListeners: int
  avgSession: string | null
  topGenre: string | null
  uniqueSongsPlayed: int
  trends: {
    playsVsPrev: number
    uniqueListenersVsPrev: number
  }
}
```

### `GET /api/dashboard/plays-over-time` — Get plays over time

Auth: none

Returns play counts as a time series. `range` accepts `today` (default), `7d`, `30d`, `90d` or `all`. When both `from` and `to` are supplied, they take precedence over `range`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `range` | query | `string` | no | default: "today" |
| `from` | query | `date-time` | no |  |
| `to` | query | `date-time` | no |  |

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  labels: string[] | null
  data: int[] | null
}
```

### `GET /api/dashboard/top-songs` — Get top songs

Auth: none

Returns the most played songs. `limit` defaults to 7. `range` accepts `today` (default), `7d`, `30d`, `90d` or `all`. When both `from` and `to` are supplied, they take precedence over `range`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `range` | query | `string` | no | default: "today" |
| `from` | query | `date-time` | no |  |
| `to` | query | `date-time` | no |  |
| `limit` | query | `int` | no | default: 7 |

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  songs: {
    id: string | null
    slug: string | null
    title: string | null
    plays: int
    thumbnailUrl: string | null
  }[] | null
}
```

### `GET /api/dashboard/top-artists` — Get top artists

Auth: none

Returns the most played original artists. `limit` defaults to 7. `range` accepts `today` (default), `7d`, `30d`, `90d` or `all`. When both `from` and `to` are supplied, they take precedence over `range`.

### `GET /api/dashboard/cover-artist-drilldown` — Get cover artist details

Auth: none

Returns top songs and totals for the cover artist given in `coverArtist`. `range` accepts `today` (default), `7d`, `30d`, `90d` or `all`. When both `from` and `to` are supplied, they take precedence over `range`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `coverArtist` | query | `string` | no |  |
| `range` | query | `string` | no | default: "today" |
| `from` | query | `date-time` | no |  |
| `to` | query | `date-time` | no |  |

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  coverArtist: string | null
  totalPlays: int
  songs: {
    id: string | null
    title: string | null
    plays: int
  }[] | null
}
```

Response `400` Bad Request `application/json`:

```ts
{
  type: string | null
  title: string | null
  status: int | null
  detail: string | null
  instance: string | null
}
```
